[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
The cemetery index gives John Glasgow’s death as 10 Jul 1911, aged 83. The spouse field names Janet Glasgow. A Turakina entry names Janet Glasgow’s spouse as John Glasgow. The names and area agree; whether the entries describe the same couple remains open.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60547/records/46024049 Ancestry, New Zealand, Cemetery Records, 1800–2007: John Glasgow, 10 Jul 1911, record 60547/46024049].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
The cemetery index names John Glasgow and spouse Janet. His earlier identity remains unresolved.
